status: qualified for build d05939967b5f (prefill grid + decode/MTP grid)
storage_policy: Visible sibling profile (not archived). Registered in ../profiles.json; configure_tunableop auto-selects it when the loaded librocblas.so.5 hashes to d05939967b5f, or when TUNABLEOP_PROFILE=rocm10-rocblas5.6 is set (validated against the loaded lib). 128 rows/rank = the curated prefill grid (44) plus a decode/MTP grid (84) tuned and qualified for this build.

imported.note: retired build; superseded by the campaign below

campaign.method: 4 GPUs tuned in parallel (10 iters, 25 ms budget); heuristic / current / new measured in one session; curated with 3% adopt and 3% drop margins.
campaign.candidates: current = tunableop/rocblas-d05939967b5f rows (same build); new = fresh tune on this build
campaign.measurement_note: Same-session repeats agree to ~0.3% median (|d|>3% on 1/70). Across sessions the same row set drifts 5-10%, so adopt/drop margins are only meaningful within one session.
campaign.finding: ours / imported / curated_v2 all measure within 0.9% of each other; all ~4% faster than the heuristic on median.

campaign_decode.why: The prefill-grid campaign left every M <= 32 shape untuned, so on this build all decode and MTP-verify GEMMs fell back to rocBLAS heuristics. The canonical rocm7.14-rocblas5.5 profile carries those shapes; this one did not.
campaign_decode.method: Tuned on GPU 0 (10 iterations, 10 ms budget per solver, numerics checked vs FP32 in-process), then replayed on all four cards against FP32 references.
campaign_decode.solver_mix: 81 Gemm_Rocblas_*, 3 Default (the heuristic won for tn_4096_8, tn_3584_7, tn_3584_8)
campaign_decode.speedups: Per-shape speedup over the heuristic ranged 1.4x to 3.6x; the largest were the K=320 and K=10240 shapes (up to 3.57x at M=16 n=10240 k=320).
campaign_decode.note: Rows are raw tuned, not curated: the prefill grid's adopt/drop margins need a same-session heuristic-vs-current-vs-new comparison, which was not run here. They cover M values disjoint from the prefill grid, so they only add.
